source.title: Queue Imbalance as a One-Tick-Ahead Price Predictor in a Limit Order Book

claims.statement: Queue imbalance is normalized best-bid size less best-ask size.
The next-up probability is a logistic function of imbalance with two fitted coefficients.

adaptations: A deterministic numerical gradient optimizer replaces the paper's unspecified fitting software; the model family and likelihood objective are retained.
The paper's probability forecast is also converted into a unit target position for contract backtesting; this trading action is not claimed as a paper result.
The local order-book fixture and labels are synthetic; the Nasdaq 2014 empirical study is not reproduced.
